description: Send plain content to an official Discord webhook and report the asynchronous delivery result.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the asynchronous Discord webhook request.

inputs.name: username
inputs.description: Optional username override for the webhook message.

inputs.name: avatar_url
inputs.description: Optional HTTPS avatar URL for the webhook message.

inputs.name: tts
inputs.description: Requests Discord text-to-speech delivery when true.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when Discord accepts the webhook request.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the request fails or Discord rejects it.

outputs.name: operation_result
outputs.description: Structured success or failure result for the webhook request.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when Discord returns a successful response.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable failure code, or empty text after a successful request.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable delivery result message.

description: Send one embed object to an official Discord webhook and report the asynchronous delivery result.

inputs.name: embed
inputs.description: Embed object produced by the Discord embed builder nodes.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when Discord accepts the embed request.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the request fails or Discord rejects it.

outputs.name: operation_result
outputs.description: Structured success or failure result for the embed request.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when Discord returns a successful response.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable failure code, or empty text after a successful request.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable delivery result message.

description: Send a sequence of content and embed messages to one official Discord webhook in order.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: Ordered message maps. Each map may contain content and an embed value. An empty list sends nothing.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after every message in the batch has been accepted.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when any message in the batch fails.

outputs.name: operation_result
outputs.description: Structured result for the ordered batch request.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when every message in the batch succeeds.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Stable failure code, or empty text after a successful batch.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Human-readable batch result message.

description: Build an embed map from title, text, color, media, author, footer, and timestamp values.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Optional URL attached to the embed title.

inputs.name: timestamp
inputs.description: Optional timestamp text in Discord's accepted timestamp format.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the embed map has been built.

outputs.name: embed
outputs.description: Embed map ready for sending or further field edits.

description: Append a named value field to an embed map.

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: Places the field beside other inline fields when true.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the field has been appended.

outputs.name: embed
outputs.description: The updated embed map.

displayName: Add Embed To Discord Webhook Data
description: Append an embed map to the embeds list in a webhook data map.

inputs.description: Embed map to append to the webhook data.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the embed has been appended.

outputs.name: webhook_data
outputs.description: Updated webhook data containing the embed list.

description: Set or replace the RGB color integer on an embed map.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Discord RGB color integer. Absent input leaves the existing color unchanged.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after color assignment.

outputs.name: embed
outputs.description: Updated embed map.

description: Parse six hexadecimal RGB digits, with or without a leading hash, into a Discord color integer.

inputs.name: hex_color
inputs.description: Six hexadecimal RGB digits, optionally prefixed with #.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the color has been parsed.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: Parsed Discord RGB color integer.

description: Pack red, green, and blue channels from 0 through 255 into a Discord color integer.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after RGB packing.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: Packed Discord RGB color integer.
